about.title: A product leader for the agentic-AI era.
paragraphs: I've spent **20+ years building across B2B enterprise security platforms and B2C consumer AI products** — a combination most PMs never get. A hands-on cloud engineering and systems-architecture background gives me the technical depth to evaluate platform trade-offs and win CXO-level buy-in, not just spec features.

My career started in **test and quality** — risk-based test frameworks, automated execution and API-level verification. That foundation now shows up as rigour around **AI evaluation, success metrics and production monitoring**: golden datasets, guardrails and pass/fail thresholds before anything goes GA.

Today I'm **Director of Product Management at Qualys**, defining the roadmap for its Agentic AI security platform — exposing agents through MCP, CLI and Slack / Teams so engineers can use them without ever opening a dashboard. I also publish on Agentic AI and enterprise product strategy, and ship hands-on AI builds in the open.

approach.throughline: **The through-line:** relentless focus on the customer's problem — and the judgment to apply AI only where it earns its place.

principles.title: Judgment over hype
principles.text: LLMs where reasoning matters, classic ML where it's cheaper, governance where earning trust unlocks adoption.

principles.title: Value-obsessed
principles.text: Every product ties to business value (cost, risk, new channels) and user value (their own tools, hours-to-minutes, trust built in).

principles.title: Ship, don't slideware
principles.text: Every product has a working, zero-install way to see it run — with metrics honestly flagged as modelled targets.

roles.title: Director of Product Management
